record.original_question: Let f be analytic near the origin and consider the planar vector field obtained from the nth Cauchy-Riemann derivative, x' = 2^n Re((partial^n/partial zbar^n)f(x,y)), y' = 2^n Im((partial^n/partial zbar^n)f(x,y)). If the origin is an isolated equilibrium point, must the index of the vector field at the origin be at most n?

evidence.quote: Problem 25 (Loewner's conjecture). Assume that the origin is an isolated equilibrium point of the differential equation (20) and that f is analytic at this point. Then the index of the associated vector field at the origin is not greater than n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be a complex-valued function that is real-analytic in a neighborhood $U\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ of the origin, where points are written as $(x,y)$ and $z=x+iy$, $\bar z=x-iy$. For a fixed positive integer $n$, define the planar vector field $X_n=(P,Q)$ on $U$ by
$$P(x,y)=2^n\,\mathrm{Re}\!\left(\frac{\partial^n f}{\partial \bar z^{\,n}}(x,y)\right),\qquad Q(x,y)=2^n\,\mathrm{Im}\!\left(\frac{\partial^n f}{\partial \bar z^{\,n}}(x,y)\right),$$
where $\partial/\partial\bar z=\tfrac12(\partial/\partial x+i\,\partial/\partial y)$. Suppose that the origin is an isolated zero of $X_n$ (i.e., an isolated equilibrium of the differential equation $(x',y')=(P,Q)$). Let $\mathrm{ind}_0(X_n)\in\mathbb{Z}$ denote the Poincaré–Hopf index of $X_n$ at the origin.

Prove or disprove: $\mathrm{ind}_0(X_n)\le n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Loewner's conjecture in this general $n$ form remains open. The case $n=2$ would imply Carathéodory's conjecture on umbilic points of convex surfaces; while several proofs of the $n=2$/Carathéodory case have been announced (e.g., Ivanov 2002, Guilfoyle–Klingenberg), they are not universally accepted, and the conjecture for general $n$ is widely regarded as open. Recent work (e.g., bounds on the index of an umbilic point, 2024) continues to investigate partial results.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on the Index of an Umbilic Point
status_evidence.snippet: Loewner conjectured that the index at 0 of the vector field given in complex notation by ∂^n f/∂\bar z^n is at most n.
status_evidence.claim: The general-n Loewner conjecture is stated as still being investigated, with only partial bounds known.

status_evidence.title: A conjecture in relation to Loewner's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The Loewner conjecture asserts that the index of an isolated singularity with respect to the n-th derivative distribution is not more than one.
status_evidence.claim: The Loewner conjecture for general n is treated as an open problem in subsequent literature.

status_evidence.title: The index of isolated umbilics on surfaces of non-positive curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses partial results on indices of umbilics, related to Carathéodory/Loewner conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are available; full conjecture not established.
